stable.notes: Server 6.39.0 adds local models through Ollama, and this build keeps your Ollama settings. The helper writes the server's environment from a fixed list of keys, so a pinned local model or loopback override would have silently vanished on every server update without this release. Pair with server 6.39.0. Also note server 6.38.1: your conversation archive will shrink dramatically after updating — a bug had been storing the same conversations repeatedly, and the fix collapses the duplicates. Nothing real is lost.

notice.title: You can now enrol a voice
notice.body: COS can tell speakers apart and remember them. Record a meeting, then open Review speakers below and give each voice a name. That name is saved as a voice profile and COS labels that person automatically from then on. Voices are learned only from meetings recorded after the voiceprint model is installed, so start with a fresh recording rather than an older meeting.
